consumes: [REQ-001]

# ADR-002: One write path through the application layer

## Context

Checkout writes arrive from two entry points.

## Decision

The application layer owns the only write path to the order store.

## Consequences

| Consequence | Direction | Affected |
|---|---|---|
| Batch import routes through the application layer | cost | REQ-001 |

## Constraints introduced

| CON | Kind | Statement |
|---|---|---|
| CON-003 | layering | The application layer holds the only write path to the order store. |
| CON-004 | performance | The checkout page loads within two seconds. |

## Supersedes

| Supersedes ADR | Retires CON |
|---|---|
| none | none |
